text:
amanda: Kicking off the api_v2 rollout now. deploy-bot shows the image pushed to staging.

deploy-bot: [ci] deploy started: service=api image=redwood/api:2026-03-10-rc4 env=staging

javier: what's the FF plan for this one? last time we saw spike when ramped too fast.

amanda: plan proposal: canary 1% for 10m, then 5% for 15m, 25% for 30m, then 100% if stable. target regions: us-west, eu-central. pin to version tag for canaries.

priya: add surge guard: if 5xx rate >1.5x baseline or p95 latency +200ms, abort and rollback flag to 0% immediately.

sasha: agree. also throttle downstream retries in the canary group (we can set header X-Feature-Group: canary)

leo: what's the command to toggle? I'll run it once CI green.

amanda: use internal CLI: 

```
# set initial canary
ffctl rollout create --flag api_v2_enable --env staging --targets "canary=1%" --tag api_v2:2026-03-10-rc4
# ramp step example
ffctl rollout update --flag api_v2_enable --env staging --targets "canary=5%"
```

javier: put the ramp schedule in the release notes and on the PR so oncall can see it.

amanda: copying schedule here for posterity:

```
{
  "flag": "api_v2_enable",
  "env": "staging",
  "schedule": [
    {"step": "canary", "percent": "1", "duration_m": "10"},
    {"step": "canary", "percent": "5", "duration_m": "15"},
    {"step": "ramp", "percent": "25", "duration_m": "30"},
    {"step": "full", "percent": "100", "duration_m": "0"}
  ],
  "abort_conditions": {
    "error_rate_multiplier": "1.5",
    "p95_latency_ms_increase": "200"
  },
  "rollback_action": "set_flag_to_0%"
}
```

deploy-bot: [ci] all e2e checks passed, staging smoke OK (basic routes). ready for canary toggle.

amanda: executing initial toggle now.

amanda: `ffctl rollout create --flag api_v2_enable --env staging --targets "canary=1%" --tag api_v2:2026-03-10-rc4` :rocket:

deploy-bot: [flag] api_v2_enable set to canary=1% (actor=amanda) at 1773201185

priya: monitoring dashboards on standby. alert thresholds set to error-rate >1.5x and p95 +200ms. I'll post updates at each step.

sasha: I'll watch downstream queue and stop retries if we see surge.

javier: also pin routing to the canary instances (service mesh rule applied) — doing that now.

leo: quick note: logging change in rc4 adds a non-blocking field. watch log size for ingestion costs.

amanda: if everything looks good at 1% we'll go to 5% in ~10m. if not, we abort and run `ffctl set api_v2_enable 0% --env staging`

priya: 10m -> 1% stable. p95 within baseline, error rate normal. :thumbsup:

amanda: moving to 5%.

amanda: `ffctl rollout update --flag api_v2_enable --env staging --targets "canary=5%"` executed at 1773201365

deploy-bot: [flag] api_v2_enable updated canary=5% (actor=amanda) at 1773201365

leo: observing slight increase in log events but within expected bounds.

sasha: queue depth steady.

priya: 5% -> metrics look good at +15m. proceeding with ramp to 25%.

amanda: ramping to 25% now and notifying product that rollout is progressing.

amanda: `ffctl rollout update --flag api_v2_enable --env staging --targets "canary=25%"` at 1773201450

javier: leaving final 100% for a follow-up window and will coordinate with infra change window for low traffic (tomorrow 02:00 UTC).

amanda: noted. linking to release notes and will schedule the full rollout during change window tomorrow.

priya: if anything degrades overnight we abort early. good job team. :clap:
